summary_en: This phase 1 study tests FT836 CAR T-cell therapy combined with daratumumab in adults with relapsed and/or refractory multiple myeloma. FT836 is given by IV injection at dose levels of 1 x 10^8, 3 x 10^8, or up to 9 x 10^8 cells per dose, and daratumumab is given intravenously at 16 mg/kg; how long or how often is not stated. The study measures safety and preliminary efficacy, but specific outcome measures are not stated in the record.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1 evalúa la terapia con células CAR T FT836 combinada con daratumumab en adultos con mieloma múltiple recidivante y/o refractario. FT836 se administra por inyección intravenosa en niveles de dosis de 1 x 10^8, 3 x 10^8 o hasta 9 x 10^8 células por dosis, y daratumumab se administra por vía intravenosa a 16 mg/kg; la duración o la frecuencia no están indicadas. El estudio mide la seguridad y la eficacia preliminar, pero las medidas de resultado específicas no están indicadas en el registro.
who_for: At least 3 prior lines of therapy, including a proteasome inhibitor, an immunomodulator, and a CD38 monoclonal antibody.
Measurable disease by serum M-protein, urine M-protein, or light chain criteria.
Karnofsky performance score of 70 or higher.
Adequate liver, kidney, heart, and lung function as defined in the study criteria.
not_for: Positive pregnancy test in a person of childbearing potential.
Confirmed active HIV, hepatitis B, or hepatitis C infection.
Significant autoimmune disease, or active autoimmune condition needing more than 20 mg prednisone daily.
Active central nervous system involvement by malignancy.
Prior gene therapy or any gene-modified cellular therapy.
